provisioning.GITDIR_POINTER: exact text installed as the .git pointer file; gitdir-target/ is copied beside it with its own HEAD
provisioning.HEAD: exact text installed as .git/HEAD; no git init and no commit run
provisioning.SYMLINK_PLAN: javaOnly: lines 'link<TAB>target' relative to the project root, created as symlinks at test time; a target starting with @outside/ points into a sibling directory created from the fixture's outside/ tree
provisioning.blank-line: a Mission whose ledger holds a blank line is served: read_events_raw skips the line and the overview counts the other events. Its streamCursor is the cursor after the whole file: offset = the file size, invariant = the SHA-256 of the last terminated line, a blank line included (tail_reader). malformed-rows/blank-line has the blank line mid-file; malformed-rows/blank-line-final ends the file with it, so its invariant is the digest of the bare newline and validate_resume_cursor and poll_once reject the non-blank digest. Only poll_once refuses the blank line, which the stream golden records
provisioning.coord-worktree: coord-worktree/<mission-dir>/ holds the contents of that Mission's coordination worktree ROOT (kitty-specs/<mission-dir>/...); installed at .worktrees/<slug>-<mid8>-coord as a registered git worktree (.worktrees/ is gitignored, so it cannot be committed in place)
provisioning.husk-worktree: husk-worktree/<mission-dir>/ holds a stale coordination worktree; installed at the same .worktrees path as a plain unregistered directory
provisioning.not-copied: golden/, HEAD, GITDIR_POINTER, gitdir-target/, coord-worktree/, husk-worktree/, SYMLINK_PLAN and outside/ are provisioning inputs and are not copied into the project root as they are
provisioning.status.events.before.jsonl: a Mission-level status.events.before.jsonl is the earlier state of the log: the stream scenario polls it first, then polls status.events.jsonl with the resulting cursor
